intro.lede: More than apps, AI and open source: nu01 systems are learnable. Each one comes with full video explanations at prodbytes.substack.com.
intro.freemium: Every service offers free access to everyone, and premium access is included for all prodbytes members.
hero.label: nu01 systems
learning.title: More than AI: people learning
learning.body: Software that teaches as it works. Every nu01 system is built in the open and explained on video, step by step, so you understand what you run and can build your own.
presence.title: Keep an eye on the places you care for
presence.body: Turn a phone, tablet or laptop into an always-on camera for your home, shop or office. Watch live, save clips that include the moments before you pressed Clip, record on motion, and tag the people and pets in each clip.
uplink.title: Find every broken link
uplink.body: uplink crawls your whole site, follows its sitemaps, and shows each broken link with the page it was found on. Watch it live in your terminal, or run a single pass in CI.
rbacr.title: Roles for every app you run
rbacr.body: Sign in with Google, grant roles to a person or a whole domain, and hand out vouchers that unlock premium. People see their roles as pages; your apps read them as JSON.
tabscan.title: Scan and share guitar tabs
tabscan.body: tabscan is a document scanner made for tablature: point your phone at a page, and it straightens it, cleans it to crisp black on white, and reads the tab as editable text. Share it as a PDF, as text, or as images.
